title: Pipeline reliability, configurable discovery, and resume-routing audit
steps: Inspect orchestration, effective eligibility, dashboard controls, source registries, and resume routing.
Reproduce high-impact findings with isolated databases, temporary files, and mocked services.
Document evidence, currently supported configuration workflows, and a prioritized improvement roadmap.
Run the repository verification gate and capture post-state.
constraints: Read production search configuration only; do not change user searches, resumes, databases, or deployed settings.
Use no paid AI inference or live discovery during audit verification.
Keep findings distinguishable from proposed fixes; avoid claiming implemented improvements.
